Cloud.ConnectScript: [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $AppId='499ca559-1b15-4660-9982-602eb5f0428d'; $Organization='icicigroup.onmicrosoft.com'; $Region='ap-south-1'; $SecretName='PROD/GAL'; $secretValue = Get-SECSecretValue -SecretId $SecretName -Region $Region; $secretJson=$secretValue.SecretString | ConvertFrom-Json; $base64Pfx=$secretJson.CertificateBase64; $plainPassword=$secretJson.CertificatePassword; $pfxPassword=ConvertTo-SecureString $plainPassword -AsPlainText -Force; $pfxBytes=[Convert]::FromBase64String($base64Pfx); $cert=New-Object System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2; $cert.Import($pfxBytes,$pfxPassword,[System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509KeyStorageFlags]::MachineKeySet -bor [System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509KeyStorageFlags]::Exportable); if (-not $cert.HasPrivateKey){ throw 'Certificate private key missing'}; Connect-ExchangeOnline -AppId $AppId -Organization $Organization -Certificate $cert -ShowBanner:$false
Cloud.GetDLWithOwner: Get-DistributionGroup -Identity "{dlName}" | Select DisplayName,ManagedBy | ForEach-Object { $owner = Get-Recipient $_.ManagedBy; [PSCustomObject]@{ DLName=$_.DisplayName; OwnerName=$owner.DisplayName; OwnerEmail=$owner.PrimarySmtpAddress } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4

AccountUnlock.Verify: Get-ADUser -Identity "{EmpId}" -Properties LockedOut, AccountExpires, Enabled, Info, PasswordLastSet, UserAccountControl | Select SamAccountName, LockedOut, AccountExpires, Enabled, Info, PasswordLastSet, UserAccountControl | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
Get-ADUser -Identity "{EmpId}" -Properties LockedOut | Select SamAccountName, LockedOut | ConvertTo-Json
